flashcard_questions.q: Music composed specifically to accompany a film, supporting the story, characters and atmosphere.
Sound that occurs within the world of the film — the characters can hear it, such as dialogue, a radio playing, or a glass smashing.
Sound added for the audience only — the characters cannot hear it, such as an underscore or a voiceover.

flashcard_questions.a: Background music that plays underneath the action of a film to create mood and atmosphere without the characters hearing it.
Notes that do not belong to the main key of the piece, creating tension or an unsettling sound.
